goal: Prevent node crashes and memory corruption caused by oversized outbound P2P messages
Reject messages exceeding protocol wire limits before queuing them for peers
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (ajtowns, naiyoma)
Resolved concern: dropping oversized messages could stall connections for minutes (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents node crashes and out-of-bounds writes during outbound transport encoding
Fixes a concrete failure mode where oversized internal or RPC-generated payloads violate wire bounds
